title: C++: Event Bus
description: Implement a typed event bus for publish-subscribe communication.

steps.title: Event Bus
steps.description: Create a template EventBus class with on(event, callback) and emit(event, data). Use function<void(T)> as callback type. Test with string events: on('login', cb) and on('logout', cb). Emit both events.
hints: void on(const string& event, function<void(T)> cb) { listeners[event].push_back(cb); }
void emit(const string& event, T data) { for (auto& cb : listeners[event]) cb(data); }
